purpose: bounded deterministic optimization over a reobserved moving target
mathematical_scope: simplex-style vertex pivots on an explicitly materialized finite feasible graph; not a claim of equivalence to every classical simplex implementation

decisions.NOOP: no evidence-bound feasible adjacent vertex strictly improves the current linear objective
decisions.HOLD: required evidence or semantic precondition is absent
decisions.REOBSERVE: target generation differs from the generation used by the current observation
decisions.PIVOT: one deterministic evidence-bound feasible neighbor strictly improves the objective

invariants: Optimization decision is not execution authority
Snapshot evidence does not transfer across target drift
Unsupported or ambiguous state fails closed
optimization_principles: reuse bound observations before cold recomputation
synchronize only at explicit causal edges
reobserve after every externally relevant effect
stop at a local evidence-bound fixpoint

product_owner_authorization.scope: repository-internal implementation, compilation, verification, autonomous continuation and evidence-based optimization; publication preparation when scientifically warranted
product_owner_authorization.publication_boundary: Zenodo/arXiv publication still requires an actually available authenticated publication path and observed publication effect; repository preparation alone is not publication
